\section{Introduction}
Weed detection in cereal fields is a prerequisite for targeted spraying. Aerial imagery from low-cost drones offers full-field coverage at centimeter resolution.

\section{Conclusion}
Our detector is the best solution for weed detection in cereal fields and should replace existing pipelines.

instruction: 审稿人三条意见，请逐条落实修改：①「方法部分缺少具体训练超参数」——在 method.tex 补充 Adam 的具体设置（学习率 0.001、batch size 64、weight decay 0.0005）；②「缺少与随机基线的对比」——在 method.tex 的评测句中加入 random baseline（按类别频率随机标注）作为对照；③「结论 overstated」——conclusion.tex 里 "is the best solution" 的表述过强，软化为有保留的表述（如 among the strongest），并把 "should replace" 也改成有分寸的说法。intro.tex 不要动。

files.content:
\section{Introduction}
Weed detection in cereal fields is a prerequisite for targeted spraying. Aerial imagery from low-cost drones offers full-field coverage at centimeter resolution.

\section{Conclusion}
Our detector is among the strongest solutions for weed detection in cereal fields and compares favorably with existing pipelines on the studied splits.
